entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4017860992519744384: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 102.3014 +/- 0.0302 mas (same row, RUWE 1.13): 9.78 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 895.088, -813.550 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.455 +/- 0.018 solar radii from Maciejewski et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of GJ 436 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014AcA....64..323M/abstract). Mass 0.47 +/- 0.07 solar masses from Maciejewski et al. 2014, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of GJ 436 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014AcA....64..323M/abstract). Temperature 3505 +/- 51 K from Maxted et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of GJ 436 b's parameter set from Maxted et al. 2022 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,505 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc78c. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,505 K and log g 4.79 (u1 0.400, u2 0.373): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
